title: Postiz analytics implementation
author: gitroomhq
technique: Keep platform-native metric semantics and exact published post IDs. Separate reach from impressions rather than copying dashboard labels.

title: Postiz per-post analytics CLI
author: gitroomhq
technique: Treat an unresolved published-post ID as a mapping failure, not a zero-engagement result. Postiz requires its own connected accounts and internal post IDs.

title: Twikit X data model
author: d60
technique: Views and engagement counters are separate fields. This unofficial session-dependent collector is a research reference, not an installed cross-platform adapter.

title: twscrape X post model and session requirements
author: vladkens
technique: Keep missing view counts nullable and record collection failures. The repository requires authorized X sessions and is not enabled by default.

title: Official Tumblr JavaScript API client
author: tumblr
technique: Use a blog and stable post ID for lookup. Aggregate note counts must not be represented as a fabricated likes/shares breakdown.

title: Tweepy official-API client patterns
author: tweepy
technique: Separate public post metrics from owner-context analytics and propagate rate-limit/access failures instead of interpreting them as poor content.

title: B2B social-content and copywriting guidance
author: coreyhaines31
technique: Test a concise buyer-decision implication supported by one specific finding, within an existing approved format; compare its mature interaction rate with the current approach.
